			<h1><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xifenfei/p/20385714" title="发布于 2026-06-08 23:28">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">硬件故障后数据文件大小不对故障处理—Oracle碎片扫描恢复</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
		</div>	
		<div class="postText">
			<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>有硬件恢复圈朋友找到我,说硬件恢复之后dbv报dbv-00102错误,让我给看看是否可以处理<br><a href="https://www.xifenfei.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/dbv-00102.jpg" rel="noopener nofollow"><img src="https://www.xifenfei.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/dbv-00102.jpg" alt="dbv-00102" width="1431" height="667" class="alignnone size-full wp-image-12190"></a></p>
<hr>这个是oracle dbv中一种常见错误,一般是由于block 0 不对,或者是由于文件大小不对引起,让把恢复文件发给我,进行检查
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div>
<div id="highlighter_393962" class="syntaxhighlighter nogutter  bash">

<p>确定USER02-USERS05的dbf文件实际大小(数据文件头记录)在8G左右,但是目前恢复出来的文件大小只有4G左右<br><a href="https://www.xifenfei.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/4g.jpg" rel="noopener nofollow"><img src="https://www.xifenfei.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/4g.jpg" alt="4g" width="751" height="349" class="alignnone size-full wp-image-12191"></a></p>
<hr>在恢复工具中直接查看文件大小情况<br><a href="https://www.xifenfei.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/rs.jpg" rel="noopener nofollow"><img src="https://www.xifenfei.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/rs.jpg" alt="rs" width="882" height="305" class="alignnone size-full wp-image-12192"></a><br><hr>这里比较明显rs中虽然显示文件状态良好,但是实际大小也不对(得出经验:以后恢复中不能太依赖这个状态),根据反馈现场是三个盘的raid5,中途做了一次强制上线,然后客户也使用win pe拷贝过一次数据,大小和现在一样,也是少了近4G.第一反应可能是由于raid盘弄的不对,但是经过对其他文件的确认,多完全没有问题,排除了盘错误的问题,怀疑是由于文件系统异常导致,对于这种的情况,文件系统层面肯定无法恢复,考虑使用自研的OraScan工具进行扫描(<a title="OraScan(Oracle 碎片扫描工具) 使用说明" href="https://www.xifenfei.com/2026/04/orascan.html" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">OraScan(Oracle 碎片扫描工具) 使用说明</a>)<br><a href="https://www.xifenfei.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/ora1.jpg" rel="noopener nofollow"><img src="https://www.xifenfei.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/ora1.jpg" alt="ora1" width="955" height="428" class="alignnone size-full wp-image-12194"></a><br><a href="https://www.xifenfei.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/ora2.png" rel="noopener nofollow"><img src="https://www.xifenfei.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/ora2.png" alt="ora2" width="949" height="535" class="alignnone size-full wp-image-12197"></a><br><hr>通过OraScan扫描找到相关block,并提取出来数据文件<br><a href="https://www.xifenfei.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/file.jpg" rel="noopener nofollow"><img src="https://www.xifenfei.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/file.jpg" alt="file" width="744" height="172" class="alignnone size-full wp-image-12196"></a><br><hr>使用dbv检测文件
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>由于redo group 异常导致库无法正常open,但是由于已经recover database成功,因此大概率可以clear该redo 组</p>
<div>
<div id="highlighter_301517" class="syntaxhighlighter nogutter  sql">

<tbody>

<div class="line number2 index1 alt1">&nbsp;</div>

<p>数据库open成功，然后使用expdp导出数据,完成本次恢复任务.</p>
